Purpose: Runs sfc /verifyonly: checks protected system files for corruption WITHOUT repairing. Run SM02 to repair any violations found. Evidence: captures native exit code, raw output, and relevant CBS.log entries. Does not claim "no violations" from exit code alone - uses Inconclusive when CBS evidence unavailable.

Runs sfc /scannow: verifies and repairs protected system files. Evidence: captures native exit code, raw output, CBS.log entries, and post-repair verify-only. Does not claim "repaired" from exit code alone - uses Inconclusive when CBS evidence unavailable.
RollbackMethod: Rerun SM02; files restored by sfc

Purpose: Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /CheckHealth: a fast check that reports whether corruption was flagged by a prior scan. It does not scan deeply and does not modify anything.
Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /ScanHealth: a full read-only scan of the component store. Does not repair.

Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth. Supports local source (install.wim / install.esd) with proper index detection. Runs CheckHealth and ScanHealth first. Runs post-repair ScanHealth. Returns Inconclusive when result cannot be proven.
Runs chkdsk /scan on the system drive: online read-only scan. Use SM07 to schedule a full repair at the next boot.
Marks the system volume dirty so autochk runs a full chkdsk (/f /r) at the next boot, then verifies the volume is dirty.
RollbackMethod: Run chkdsk /f /r; use fsutil dirty query

Purpose: Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore to report WinSxS component store size and whether cleanup is recommended.

Safe Windows Update repair: records the start mode and running state of the WU services, stops them, renames (never deletes) the SoftwareDistribution DataStore + Download folders, then restores each service to its original start mode and running state. Valid statuses: Success, Warning, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped, Inconclusive.
RollbackMethod: Rename folders back; original service start types re-applied and verified

Purpose: Aggregates maintenance-relevant facts: OS/build, uptime, free space, last SFC/CBS activity, and component store size.
Cleans the current user temp folders, quarantining removable files and skipping ones in use.
BackupMethod: Files moved to Quarantine via Invoke-KnouxCleanup

Purpose: Permanently empties the Recycle Bin for all drives after a typed confirmation. Nothing here can be restored afterwards.
Cleans browser cache folders PER PROFILE for the current user (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox). Never touches other users or system folders such as SoftwareDistribution.
BackupMethod: Files moved to Quarantine per profile

Purpose: Cleans WER (Windows Error Reporting) files under ProgramData. Never touches CBS.log or DISM.log.
BackupMethod: Files moved to Quarantine via Invoke-KnouxCleanup

Purpose: Measures how much space is reclaimable in common locations WITHOUT deleting anything.

Removes the contents of %SystemRoot%\SoftwareDistribution\Download only (never DataStore, never the whole SoftwareDistribution folder). Required services (wuauserv, bits, cryptsvc) are stopped for the cleanup and their start type and running state are restored and verified afterwards. If ANY required service cannot be stopped and verified, cleanup is ABORTED.
BackupMethod: Cache files moved to Quarantine; wuauserv start type/state saved
RollbackMethod: Restore from Quarantine folder; wuauserv start type restored and verified

Purpose: Cleans C:\Windows\Temp. Files in use are skipped silently.
BackupMethod: Files moved to Quarantine via Invoke-KnouxCleanup

Purpose: Finds and removes temp files larger than 100 MB in the user and system temp locations.
Removes the Explorer thumbnail cache (regenerated on demand).
BackupMethod: Files moved to Quarantine via Invoke-KnouxCleanup

Purpose: Runs the full cleanup sequence (temp, system temp, update cache, thumbnail cache, WER) after a single typed confirmation.
Pings the default gateway and a public address (8.8.8.8) to test LAN and internet connectivity (read-only).
ipconfig /release then /renew on all adapters.
Flushes the DNS resolver cache with ipconfig /flushdns and records the result (requires admin).
netsh winsock reset. A restart is required afterwards.
RollbackMethod: None; restart then re-add any custom LSPs

Purpose: Flushes NetBIOS cache, ARP table and re-registers DNS records.
Pings 8.8.8.8 ten times and reports latency/jitter statistics to gauge connection quality (read-only).
Shows the full network configuration (ipconfig /all) and per-adapter details into a JSON report (read-only).
netsh winsock reset + netsh int ip reset. Restart required.
RollbackMethod: None; restart then reconfigure static IPs

Purpose: Restores sane TCP auto-tuning and congestion defaults. Saves the previous values for rollback.
BackupMethod: System Restore point via New-KnouxRestorePoint; previous values saved
RollbackMethod: System Restore; or reapply previous registry values

Purpose: Combines connectivity, configuration, and quality results into one network report (read-only).
Lists installed programs from the Uninstall registry hives (user + machine) into a JSON report (read-only).

Repairs common obstacles to clean installs of user programs: clears the per-user Windows Installer cache lock, removes stale MSI install-session markers, and repairs the Windows Installer service startup type. Never removes programs, only install scaffolding.
Detects leftover folders in %ProgramFiles% / %ProgramFiles(x86)% whose program is no longer registered in the Uninstall registry hive. Candidate folders are moved to quarantine (never hard-deleted).
Fixes Start Menu and desktop shortcuts whose target path is broken. Shortcuts pointing to the Recycle Bin root are skipped (false positive).
Lists startup entries (Run/RunOnce for HKLM + HKCU). Enables the user to disable selected startup programs by moving the registry value to a parallel backup key (registry backup, not deletion).
BackupMethod: Registry values moved to parallel backup key

Purpose: Reports the presence/version of common runtime components: .NET Framework, Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributables, and the WebView2 runtime. No changes are ever made.
Lists provisioned Windows Store apps. Lets the user remove selected apps for the current user (or machine-wide when run as admin).
Re-registers the Windows Installer and clears common blockers that prevent programs from uninstalling cleanly: dead installer mutexes, stale "Installer" cache entries, and locked setup registrations.
Uses winget to list installed programs that have newer versions available. Read-only: reports only, never updates.
Aggregates program-health facts into one report: installed count, startup count, broken shortcuts, missing runtimes, and recent installs.
Finds groups of duplicate files under the selected folders using content hashing and reports recoverable space without deleting anything.
Quarantines duplicate file copies under selected folders (oldest keeper preserved) to reclaim space, with everything recoverable from quarantine.
BackupMethod: Duplicate files moved to Quarantine (keeper preserved)

Purpose: Detects duplicate image files by content hash and quarantines the redundant copies, keeping the oldest keeper, recoverable from quarantine.
BackupMethod: Duplicate pictures moved to Quarantine (keeper preserved)

Purpose: Detects duplicate document files by content hash and quarantines the redundant copies, keeping the oldest keeper, recoverable from quarantine.
BackupMethod: Duplicate documents moved to Quarantine (keeper preserved)

Purpose: Detects duplicate music and video files by content hash and quarantines the redundant copies, keeping the oldest keeper, recoverable from quarantine.
BackupMethod: Duplicate music/video moved to Quarantine (keeper preserved)

Purpose: Finds and quarantines empty folders under the selected roots (reparse points skipped), recovering directory clutter safely.
Moves duplicate file copies into a dedicated folder under the selected root so nothing is deleted, keeping the oldest keeper in place.
BackupMethod: Duplicates copied/moved to a folder (keeper preserved)
RollbackMethod: Copy back from the duplicates folder

Purpose: Deduplicates the Downloads folder: duplicate copies are quarantined (oldest keeper preserved) and recoverable.
BackupMethod: Duplicate downloads moved to Quarantine (keeper preserved)

Purpose: Lists duplicate files found in system/Program Files locations by content hash (read-only report).
Lists quarantine entries for duplicate-file tools and allows selective restoration with verification. Read-only until user confirms a restore action.
Measures disk space usage per drive and reports free/used capacity and per-folder sizes into a JSON report (read-only).
Finds the largest files under user folders using a streaming top-N enumerator (iterative, skips reparse points and offline files, never materializes the whole tree).
Ranks folders under user folders by total size using a streaming top-N folder enumerator (iterative post-order, skips reparse points and offline files, never materializes the whole tree).
Empties the Recycle Bin for all drives after typed confirmation; reports the space recovered (permanent).
Clears the File History cache if it is disabled/unused. If File History is active, reports instead of clearing.
BackupMethod: File History cache moved to Quarantine

Purpose: CompactOS: compresses Windows system files (binary-level). Runs `compact /compactos:always`; reports size impact. Requires admin.
Checks disk health via Win32_DiskDrive (SMART status), without any destructive action. Reports per-physical-disk status.
Runs the built-in Windows Disk Cleanup (cleanmgr) with a preset set of safe categories via an ini-driven invocation. Requires user confirmation; launches the interactive dialog if no preset.
Disables hibernation (frees the hiberfil.sys file). Shows the reclaimed space. Can be re-enabled with `powercfg /h on`.
Aggregates disk usage, top large files, and space hogs into a report.
Lists Windows services with name, display name, status, and start type into a JSON report (read-only).
Lists top processes by CPU and memory usage, plus total memory load.
Restarts Windows Explorer (shell) to clear UI glitches and memory. Safe: explorer.exe is excluded from the protected-process kill list.
Lists hung (not-responding) user processes and offers to end them. System/protected processes are excluded.

Resets the start type of a set of well-known Windows services to Microsoft defaults. Current start modes are backed up to Backups\ before any change and every change is verified afterwards. Includes a read-only UAC/DEP audit; UAC and DEP are never disabled by this tool.
BackupMethod: Current start types backed up to Backups before change
RollbackMethod: Restore from Backups; every change verified

Purpose: Stops, then restarts the Windows Update services. Preserves the original start types. Safe (no deletion, no cache clearing here).
BackupMethod: Original start types preserved; services restarted

Purpose: Shows the dependency tree for a requested service or lists services that have dependencies. Read-only.

Read-only audit of service configuration with controlled change capability. Changes are permitted ONLY from an explicit Config allowlist supplied by the administrator. No generic disable recommendations.
BackupMethod: Original StartType of each changed service in service-start-backup.json (raw-output)

Purpose: Restores service start types previously backed up by SP08 (Service Recommendations). It scans the Reports tree for service-start-backup.json files, lists the runs that contain one, loads the chosen backup and offers to restore each service to its original start type. Restored start types are verified after the change.
RollbackMethod: Re-run SP08 backup flow to re-disable if needed

Purpose: Generates a full diagnostic report on services and processes: counts by state/start-mode, top consumers, suspicious entries, hung processes. Read-only, safe.
Measures the current boot duration and system uptime using performance data and the boot event log when available.
Lists startup commands from all locations (Run keys, startup folders, services) so the user can spot impact on boot time.
Audits all power plans and shows which one is active. Read-only.
Reports physical memory usage, page file pressure, and the top processes by working set.
Reports disk free space, whether the media is solid state, and the TRIM setting (DisableDeleteNotify) via fsutil when readable.
Reviews scheduled tasks, flagging tasks that failed to run or tasks that are enabled and might affect responsiveness.
Samples CPU, memory, and disk activity over a short window and reports averages and peaks.
Reads thermal zone temperature via ACPI WMI when the hardware exposes it. On most desktops this class is absent; the tool then reports 'not available' instead of failing.
Reads the current visual effects setting and can optionally switch to 'adjust for best performance' after backing up the current registry values. Changes are verified after writing.
BackupMethod: Registry values backed up before change; changes verified
RollbackMethod: Restore previous registry values from backup

Purpose: Aggregates boot, startup, memory, disk, power plan, and thermal data into one performance report saved under raw-output.
Reports the status of key security controls: real-time protection, firewall (all profiles), UAC, and Defender signature age.
Enables Windows Defender real-time protection and restores its service startup if it was disabled.

Repairs Microsoft Defender without ever stopping or disabling it: ensures the WinDefend service is set to Automatic and running, re-enables real-time protection, and refreshes signatures. The Defender service is never stopped or disabled.
Reports Windows Firewall status for all profiles using the firewall API (read-only).
Enables Windows Firewall on all profiles.

Repairs the Windows Firewall: exports a policy backup, ensures the firewall service (mpssvc) and base filtering engine (BFE) are running, then enables the firewall on all profiles and verifies the result. This tool can never disable the firewall.

Shows the current UAC configuration and can only ever ENABLE UAC (restore the default level) after a registry backup. UAC is never disabled by this tool; read-only status is shown even without admin rights.
BackupMethod: Registry backed up before enabling UAC

Purpose: Runs a Windows Defender scan (Full by default; pass -Quick for a quick scan). This can take a long time on large disks.
Comprehensive security report: Defender status, signatures, firewall profiles, UAC, recent threat detections. Read-only.
Forces Windows Defender to download the latest virus definitions.
Collects core system facts: OS version, build, architecture, uptime, installed RAM, and machine name into a JSON report.
Summarizes installed hardware: CPU, motherboard, disk, and video devices via WMI into a JSON report (read-only).
Lists recent Error-level events from System and Application logs.
Summarizes Windows reliability records from Win32_ReliabilityRecords (crashes, warnings, failures) over the last N days.
Lists installed signed drivers and flags drivers with problems.
Reports last boot time, boot duration (from the event log), and current performance counters.
Reports physical memory configuration and usage. Read-only.
Shows SMART health status for physical disks. Read-only.
Live snapshot of CPU, memory, disk, and network performance.
Combines system, hardware, disk, memory, and event information into one report. Read-only.
